-- Residual invalid/null values in processed output
SELECT
    'Ungoverned' AS Mode,
    COUNT(*) AS InvalidSCADARows
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s1/r1/DISPATCH_UNIT_SCADA/**',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS u
WHERE SCADAVALUE IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Governed',
    COUNT(*)
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/governed/s1/r1/DISPATCH_UNIT_SCADA/**',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS g
WHERE SCADAVALUE IS NULL;


-- Impact on derived field
SELECT
    'Ungoverned' AS Mode,
    COUNT(*) AS NullIntervalMWh
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s1/r1/DISPATCH_UNIT_SCADA/**',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS u
WHERE INTERVAL_MWH IS NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Governed',
    COUNT(*)
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/governed/s1/r1/DISPATCH_UNIT_SCADA/**',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS g
WHERE INTERVAL_MWH IS NULL;
